200 with created = false and duplicateCandidates when an in-scope customer already has one of the
            contact emails/phones; re-send with confirmDuplicate = true to create anyway.
A POST with the rowversion body (like /deactivate), not a DELETE with a body.

get.summary: Queues and search. queue = mine, unassigned or all (default); status and priority may repeat.
Active staff of the department (in your scope), or of every department in your scope. Pickers only.
Every active department of the tenant a ticket can be transferred to (tickets.assign).

post.summary: Action is one of Open, AwaitCustomer, PutOnHold, Resolve, Close, Reopen, Cancel.
Takes no rowVersion: two simultaneous claims have one winner, the loser gets 409 Tickets.AlreadyClaimed.
Moves the ticket to another active department of the tenant; clears the assignee and category.

get.summary:
The conversation, oldest first. visibility: public (messages), internal (notes), system (history);
            repeat it, or omit it for all three. Pass nextCursor as `after` for the next page.

post.summary: An agent reply (public). No rowVersion: replies never conflict with other edits.
Records a reply the customer sent outside the CRM (until channels exist). Public.
An internal note - staff only, never in the public thread.

CreateCustomerOutcome.description:
Created = false: nothing was written; the candidates are in-scope customers with a matching contact
            email or phone. Re-send with ConfirmDuplicate = true to create anyway.

CustomerDto.description: Contacts: primary first, then by name. Notes: pinned first, then newest first.

RefreshRequest.description: Both fields optional: the browser sends an empty body and the cookie carries the token.

TicketAgentDto.description: An active staff member who can take tickets of the listed departments (Story 20 pickers).

TicketCategoryDto.description: The admin row and the picker item.

TicketCategoryRefDto.description: What a ticket shows of its category - also when the category was deactivated later.

TicketCustomerRefDto.description: The customer a list row belongs to (Story 20). Null on the row when the caller cannot see the customer.

TicketDepartmentRefDto.description: A department named by a Transferred activity.

TicketThreadEntryDto.description:
One thread entry. Type (Message | Note | Activity) and Visibility (Public | Internal | System) map 1:1.
            Messages and notes carry Body (plain text - render as text, never as HTML); messages carry Direction
            (Inbound | Outbound) and RecordedById; activities carry TemplateKey (the activity kind, e.g. "PriorityChanged")
            and Parameters ("from", "to": machine values the UI resolves). AuthorId: agent id, contact id, or null for the
            customer (inbound messages); the actor for activities.

TicketThreadPageDto.description:
A page of the thread, oldest first. NextCursor: pass it as `after` for the next page; null = no more.
            The lookups name every staff user, category and department the page's entries refer to.

Bearer.description: Access token: staff from POST /api/Agent/Auth/login, customer from POST /api/Portal/Auth/login
